independent_source_sass_review.reviewers: Root and independent subagent inspected source, exact compile flags, ptxas output and SASS; no second compile or device run.
independent_source_sass_review.resource_observation: M4 Gate/Up: 128 registers, 34,816 shared bytes, 8 stack bytes, 8 static spill-store bytes and 4 static spill-load bytes. Other five consumers have zero reported spills. M4 Down uses 138 registers, so no global 128-register cap explains the result.
independent_source_sass_review.control_flow: Entry 0x0190 reads input exceptional flag; 0x01a0 reads scale flag; 0x01e0 branches to exceptional body 0xa080. Spill sites belong to ordinary finite body. STL 0x5e80 and 0x5f80 are mutually exclusive arms joining at 0x5fd0; LDL 0x7e10 restores an accumulator used at FFMA 0x8060/0x8130. Loop counter increments at 0x9340, with 0x9380 backedge to 0x09a0; loop count K>>9=10.
independent_source_sass_review.dynamic_logical_accesses: Each thread executes one 4-byte store and one 4-byte load per K512 tile: 80 bytes across ten tiles. N17408 / 16 outputs per CTA = 1088 CTAs, 128 threads each, or 11,141,120 logical local-memory bytes per Gate or Up projection. These are instruction-derived accesses, not observed DRAM bytes, stalls or latency.
independent_source_sass_review.prior_lesson: Earlier static register/spill stops did not establish whole-product slowdown. This closure follows the fixed local package budget only; do not turn zero-spill into a global performance or safety rule.
